value.rationale: The theorem gives a shape-universal exact link between the first nonzero affine-invariant isotropic response and a classical Euclidean isoperimetric deficit, with an inverse perimeter diagnostic and a sharp fixed-area rigidity characterization. The nontrivial second-moment and centroid cancellation extends beyond regular geometry and is not a generic textbook consequence. The claim is local and does not inflate into an all-radius theorem.
